name: Gibbet post
description: A tall weathered oak post on a cross of braced sills with an arm pegged through its top, from which a short chain hangs an iron body cage of flat hoops and straps shaped to a person from the feet to a domed head.

provenance.prompt: A tall post with an arm and a hanging iron body cage, about 1.5 × 0.8 × 4 m.
